'''2022 MPC Steve Harpster LS LTWWv Rendezvous Point''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Steve Harpster]] at [[2022 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Steve Harpster]]
* '''Event:''' [[2022 Match Play Championship]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' —
* '''Starting Interrupt:''' {{CardLink|Let The Wookiee Win (V)|V15-L-letthewookieewin.gif}}
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:Open Let The Wookiee Win (V) Harpster LS.txt |Download]]
